title: 明石海峽大橋~Akashi Kaikyo Bridge
focus: 以數字深入明石海峽大橋：顫振裕度、高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱、地震後幾何修正與主纜乾燥空氣~Numbers behind Akashi Kaikyo: flutter margin, high-strength wire, laid-down caissons, post-quake geometry correction and dry-air cables
summary: 本延伸課程接在既有的概念步驟之後，改以定量模型深入明石海峽大橋：桁架加勁梁的顫振估算、長週期模態、約 1,760 N/mm² 鋼絲的單纜斷面、80 m 直徑鋼沉箱的水中混凝土、索股垂度的溫度敏感度、1995 年地震後桁段加長的幾何推算，以及吊索尾流振動、塔內 TMD 與主纜乾燥空氣的維護數據。~This extension follows the existing conceptual steps and goes quantitative on the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge: a flutter estimate for the truss stiffening girder, long-period modes, the single-cable section made possible by wire of about 1,760 N/mm², underwater concrete in an 80 m diameter steel caisson, the temperature sensitivity of strand sag, the geometry behind lengthening truss members after the 1995 earthquake, and maintenance data for hanger wake vibration, tower TMDs and dry-air injection.

units.anchor: 桁架加勁梁顫振裕度~Truss flutter margin
units.title: 桁架加勁梁的顫振臨界風速~Flutter onset of the truss stiffening girder
units.mechanism: 主跨接近 2 km 時，加勁梁的扭轉頻率與豎彎頻率都很低，風在某一速度下會讓兩者耦合成自激的顫振：氣動力隨扭轉角輸入能量，總阻尼由正轉負，振幅在數個週期內發散。明石海峽大橋採用約 35.5 m 寬、14 m 深的開放式鋼桁架，橋面設置格柵開口與中央垂直穩定板，目的是打亂橋面上下的壓力差、提高顫振臨界風速。桁架斷面的氣動導數與流線形箱梁差異很大，只能靠斷面模型與全橋模型試驗確定。~When the main span approaches 2 km, both the torsional and the vertical bending frequencies of the stiffening girder are very low, and at some wind speed the two couple into self-excited flutter: aerodynamic forces feed energy through the twist angle, total damping turns negative and the amplitude diverges within a few cycles. Akashi Kaikyo uses an open steel truss about 35.5 m wide and 14 m deep, with gratings in the deck and a central vertical stabiliser, to disrupt the pressure difference across the deck and raise the flutter onset speed. The aerodynamic derivatives of a truss differ greatly from those of a streamlined box, so they can only be fixed by section-model and full-bridge model tests.
units.model: Selberg 平板估算 U_F = 0.44·B·ω_T·√[(1 − (f_B/f_T)²)·√(m·I)/(ρB³)]。取 B = 35.5 m、m = 44,000 kg/m、I = 6.0×10⁶ kg·m²/m、f_B = 0.065 Hz、f_T = 0.16 Hz、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³：ω_T = 1.005 rad/s，√(m·I)/(ρB³) = 513,800/55,920 = 9.19，U_F = 0.44×35.5×1.005×√(0.835×9.19) ≈ 43 m/s；f_T 提高到 0.18 Hz 時約 50 m/s。數值為教學假設，平板公式對桁架只作量級比較。~Selberg flat-plate estimate U_F = 0.44·B·ω_T·√[(1 − (f_B/f_T)²)·√(m·I)/(ρB³)]. With B = 35.5 m, m = 44,000 kg/m, I = 6.0×10⁶ kg·m²/m, f_B = 0.065 Hz, f_T = 0.16 Hz and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³: ω_T = 1.005 rad/s, √(m·I)/(ρB³) = 513,800/55,920 = 9.19, so U_F = 0.44×35.5×1.005×√(0.835×9.19) ≈ 43 m/s; raising f_T to 0.18 Hz gives about 50 m/s. Values are teaching assumptions; for a truss the flat-plate formula only gives an order of magnitude.
units.verify: 以斷面模型強迫振動試驗量測 Scanlan 氣動導數 H*、A*，代入多模態顫振分析求臨界風速，再與全橋氣彈模型在紊流中的發散風速比較；驗收以顫振臨界風速高於規範的照查風速（設計風速乘陣風與安全係數）為準，並檢查不同風攻角（例如 ±3°）下的最低值。~Measure Scanlan aerodynamic derivatives H* and A* with forced-oscillation section-model tests, feed them into a multi-mode flutter analysis, and compare the predicted onset speed with the divergence speed of a full aeroelastic model in turbulent flow; acceptance requires the flutter onset to exceed the code verification speed (design wind times gust and safety factors), checking the lowest value over angles of attack such as ±3°.
units.failure: 若沿用平板或箱梁的經驗值而未針對桁架做試驗，可能高估臨界風速；顫振一旦發生，扭轉振幅在數分鐘內增長，1940 年塔科馬海峽橋就是以扭轉發散破壞。格柵被雜物或後加設備堵塞，也會讓實橋氣動特性偏離試驗斷面。~Borrowing flat-plate or box-girder values without testing the truss can overestimate the onset speed; once flutter starts, torsional amplitude grows within minutes, as in the torsional collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940. Gratings blocked by debris or later-added equipment also move the real deck away from the tested section.
units.misconception: 桁架加勁梁很深很重，所以不會發生顫振。~A truss stiffening girder is deep and heavy, so it cannot flutter.
units.practice: 任何在加勁桁架上新增的檢修走道、管線或防護網，都要先由風工程師評估對格柵開孔率與穩定板的影響，必要時補做斷面模型試驗；維護計畫須把格柵清潔列為定期項目。~Any walkway, duct or screen added to the stiffening truss must first be assessed by the wind engineer for its effect on grating porosity and the stabiliser, with a new section-model test if needed; the maintenance plan must list grating cleaning as a routine item.

units.anchor: 長週期豎彎模態~Long-period vertical modes
units.title: 長週期模態與地震輸入~Long-period modes and seismic input
units.mechanism: 懸索橋的豎向勁度主要來自主纜的重力張力，而不是加勁梁的彎曲勁度，因此低階模態週期可長達十秒以上，像一條張緊的弦。這使主跨對短週期地震加速度不敏感，卻對長週期地震波、海峽地盤的大變位與基礎間的相對位移很敏感。明石海峽大橋的耐震設計考慮規模 8.5 級的板塊交界地震，並把基礎設在避開活動斷層的位置；但 1995 年兵庫縣南部地震的斷層錯動仍使地盤與基礎一起移動，提醒設計者：相對位移與絕對加速度是兩個不同的設計問題。~The vertical stiffness of a suspension bridge comes mainly from the gravity tension in its main cables rather than the bending stiffness of the stiffening girder, so the lowest modes can have periods of more than ten seconds, like a taut string. The main span is therefore insensitive to short-period ground acceleration but sensitive to long-period waves, large ground displacement in the strait and relative movement between foundations. The Akashi Kaikyo design considered a magnitude 8.5 interplate earthquake and sited foundations away from active faults, yet in the 1995 Hyogo-ken Nanbu earthquake fault movement still carried the ground and foundations together, a reminder that relative displacement and absolute acceleration are two separate design problems.
units.model: 以弦近似，反對稱第一豎彎頻率 f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m)。取兩纜合計 H = 1,074 MN、m = 44,000 kg/m、l = 1,991 m：√(1.074×10⁹/44,000) = 156 m/s，f ≈ 156/1,991 = 0.078 Hz，週期約 12.7 s。若 m 增加 10%，週期增為約 13.4 s。數值為教學假設。~In the string approximation the first antisymmetric vertical frequency is f ≈ (1/l)·√(H/m). With H = 1,074 MN for both cables, m = 44,000 kg/m and l = 1,991 m: √(1.074×10⁹/44,000) = 156 m/s, f ≈ 156/1,991 = 0.078 Hz and the period is about 12.7 s. A 10% increase in m lengthens the period to about 13.4 s. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 把手算弦頻率與有限元素模態分析比較，確認前幾個模態的形狀（對稱、反對稱、側向、扭轉）與排序；耐震檢核需同時輸入長週期設計波與各基礎不同步的地盤位移，並把塔頂、索鞍與伸縮縫的相對位移與容許值逐一比對。~Compare the hand string frequency with finite-element modal analysis, confirming the shape and order of the first modes (symmetric, antisymmetric, lateral, torsional); seismic checks must input long-period design motions and non-synchronous ground displacement at each foundation, comparing relative displacement at tower tops, saddles and expansion joints with their allowances.
units.failure: 只用單一同步地震波分析時，會低估塔與錨碇之間的相對位移，伸縮縫、支承與索鞍可能超出行程；長週期波若與主跨低階模態接近，加勁梁位移可能遠大於以加速度反應譜估算的結果。~Analysing with a single synchronous record underestimates relative movement between towers and anchorages, so expansion joints, bearings and saddles may exceed their travel; long-period waves near the low modes of the main span can produce girder displacements far larger than an acceleration-spectrum estimate.
units.misconception: 懸索橋很柔，所以地震對它幾乎沒有影響。~A suspension bridge is so flexible that earthquakes hardly affect it.
units.practice: 耐震設計書應列出各基礎的地盤位移假設與斷層位置圖，並把相對位移需求寫進伸縮縫、支承與索鞍的採購規格；完工後的模態實測要回饋修正模型，作為日後事件評估的基準。~The seismic design report should list ground-displacement assumptions for each foundation with a fault-location map, and write the relative-displacement demand into expansion-joint, bearing and saddle specifications; measured modes after completion must update the model as the baseline for future event assessments.

units.anchor: 1,760 N/mm² 鍍鋅鋼絲~1,760 N/mm² galvanised wire
units.title: 高強度鋼絲與單纜斷面~High-strength wire and the single-cable section
units.mechanism: 主纜是懸索橋最難更換的構件，其強度決定跨度上限。本州四國連絡橋公團公開說明：若沿用 160 kgf/mm²（約 1,570 N/mm²）鋼絲，明石海峽大橋每側需要兩條約 1,000 mm 的主纜；開發 180 kgf/mm²（約 1,760 N/mm²，製造商資料稱 1,770 MPa 級）鋼絲後，每側只需一條約 1,100 mm 主纜。每條主纜由 290 股、每股 127 根 5.23 mm 鍍鋅鋼絲組成。鋼絲強度提高也提高了工作應力，因此鍍鋅層、乾燥空氣與疲勞細部變得更關鍵。~The main cable is the hardest member of a suspension bridge to replace, and its strength sets the span limit. The Honshu-Shikoku authority states that with 160 kgf/mm² wire (about 1,570 N/mm²) Akashi Kaikyo would have needed two cables of about 1,000 mm on each side; with newly developed 180 kgf/mm² wire (about 1,760 N/mm², quoted by the steelmaker as the 1,770 MPa class) one cable of about 1,100 mm per side sufficed. Each cable has 290 strands of 127 galvanised wires of 5.23 mm. Higher wire strength also raises working stress, so the zinc coating, dry air and fatigue details become more critical.
units.model: 單絲面積 a = π/4×5.23² = 21.48 mm²，每纜 290×127 = 36,830 根，A = 36,830×21.48 ≈ 791,200 mm²；破斷力 = 791,200×1,760 ≈ 1,393 MN。若用 1,570 N/mm² 鋼絲提供相同破斷力需 886,900 mm²，多約 12%。主纜外徑約 1.122 m，毛面積 0.989 m²，空隙率 = 1 − 0.791/0.989 ≈ 20%。~Wire area a = π/4×5.23² = 21.48 mm², with 290×127 = 36,830 wires per cable, A = 36,830×21.48 ≈ 791,200 mm²; breaking force = 791,200×1,760 ≈ 1,393 MN. Supplying the same force with 1,570 N/mm² wire needs 886,900 mm², about 12% more. With an outer diameter of about 1.122 m the gross area is 0.989 m² and the void ratio = 1 − 0.791/0.989 ≈ 20%.
units.verify: 鋼絲出廠要逐捲抽驗抗拉強度、伸長率、扭轉與捲繞試驗及鍍鋅附著量（製造商資料指出長大橋鋼絲鍍鋅量常在 300 g/m² 以上），索股完成後量測長度標記與直徑；架設後以纜徑量測與空隙率計算確認擠壓品質。~Sample every coil for tensile strength, elongation, torsion and wrapping tests and zinc coating mass (the steelmaker notes that long-span bridge wire is usually coated with 300 g/m² or more), check length marks and diameter on each finished strand, and after erection confirm squeezing quality by measured cable diameter and computed void ratio.
units.failure: 高強度鋼絲對氫脆與應力腐蝕更敏感，鍍鋅層若在運輸或擠壓時刮傷，加上潮濕空氣，就可能出現局部腐蝕坑與脆性斷絲；斷絲在纜內不易察覺，累積到一定比例才顯現為安全係數下降。~High-strength wire is more sensitive to hydrogen embrittlement and stress corrosion; zinc scratched during transport or squeezing, combined with humid air, can start local pits and brittle wire breaks that are hard to see inside the cable and only appear as a loss of safety factor once enough have accumulated.
units.misconception: 鋼絲強度越高，主纜就越不需要防蝕。~The stronger the wire, the less corrosion protection the cable needs.
units.practice: 鋼絲規格要同時規定強度、韌性指標（扭轉次數）與鍍鋅量，並要求每捲可追溯到爐號；擠壓與纏絲作業須設保護措施避免刮傷鍍鋅層，損傷處的修補方法與允收須事先核准。~Wire specifications must set strength, ductility indicators such as torsion turns and zinc mass together, with every coil traceable to its heat; squeezing and wrapping must protect the zinc from scratches, and repair methods and acceptance for damaged spots must be approved in advance.

units.anchor: 2P 鋼沉箱與水中混凝土~2P steel caisson and underwater concrete
units.title: 設置沉箱與抗水洗混凝土~Laying-down caisson and antiwashout concrete
units.mechanism: 主塔基礎位於水深約 60 m、潮流最大約 8 節的海峽中，無法築圍堰抽乾。做法是先開挖整平海床，再把工廠製造的雙壁圓形鋼沉箱拖航到位、灌水沉放（設置沉箱工法），然後在沉箱內以抗水洗水中混凝土分層澆置，讓鋼殼成為永久模板。2P 沉箱外徑 80 m、內徑 56 m、高約 65 m，內核混凝土約 270,000 m³；基礎周邊再鋪濾層與拋石防止強潮流沖刷。~The tower foundations sit in about 60 m of water with tidal currents up to about 8 knots, where no cofferdam can be pumped dry. The seabed is excavated and levelled, a factory-built double-walled circular steel caisson is towed into place and ballasted down (the laying-down caisson method), and antiwashout underwater concrete is then placed in layers inside it, the steel shell acting as permanent formwork. The 2P caisson is 80 m in outer diameter, 56 m inner, about 65 m high, with about 270,000 m³ of core concrete; filter layers and rock armour around it resist scour by the strong currents.
units.model: 內核面積 = π/4×56² ≈ 2,463 m²，每層 4 m，單次澆置約 2,463×4 ≈ 9,850 m³，連續約 72 h，平均 9,850/72 ≈ 137 m³/h；六台泵各 110 m³/h，總能力 660 m³/h，平均利用率約 21%。24 支澆置管平均各負責 2,463/24 ≈ 103 m²，等效半徑 √(103/π) ≈ 5.7 m，小於 8 m 流動距離上限。面積與層厚引自公開論文，其餘為推算。~Core area = π/4×56² ≈ 2,463 m²; with 4 m layers each pour is about 2,463×4 ≈ 9,850 m³, placed continuously over about 72 h, an average of 9,850/72 ≈ 137 m³/h; six pumps of 110 m³/h give 660 m³/h of capacity, about 21% average utilisation. Each of 24 tremie pipes serves about 2,463/24 ≈ 103 m², an equivalent radius of √(103/π) ≈ 5.7 m, within the 8 m flow-distance limit. Area and layer thickness come from a published paper; the rest is derived.
units.verify: 澆置中以測深錘或感測器追蹤各管周邊混凝土面高程，確保管口埋入深度與層面平整；試體量測水中與氣中強度比、坍流度與凝結時間；完成後鑽心取樣檢查層間結合與空洞，並以海床測深監測沉箱周邊沖刷。~During placement track the concrete surface around each pipe with sounding weights or sensors to keep pipe embedment and a level surface; test specimens for the underwater-to-air strength ratio, slump flow and setting time; afterwards core through layers to check bond and voids, and monitor scour around the caisson by seabed soundings.
units.failure: 水中混凝土若抗水洗性不足或管口拔出，水泥漿被潮流帶走，形成骨材鬆散層與層間弱面；某一區流動距離過長則產生材料分離。基礎周邊沖刷若未及時防護，可能淘空沉箱邊緣、降低承載與抗傾覆能力。~Concrete with poor washout resistance, or a pipe lifted out of the mass, lets the current strip the paste and leaves loose aggregate and weak layer joints; excessive flow distance in one zone causes segregation. Unchecked scour around the foundation can undermine the caisson edge and reduce bearing and overturning capacity.
units.misconception: 水中混凝土只要配比強度夠高，澆置方式不影響品質。~If the underwater mix is strong enough, the placing method does not affect quality.
units.practice: 水中混凝土計畫應規定管口最小埋深、最大流動距離、層間間隔時間與停止條件，並在試驗槽先做足尺試澆；沉箱就位精度與海床整平度列為進入澆置前的停留點，由監造簽認。~The underwater concreting plan must fix minimum pipe embedment, maximum flow distance, layer interval and stop conditions, with a full-scale trial pour in a test tank; caisson positioning accuracy and seabed levelness are hold points signed by the supervising engineer before placement begins.

units.anchor: 預製平行鋼絲索股垂度~PWS strand sag
units.title: 索股垂度的溫度敏感度~Temperature sensitivity of strand sag
units.mechanism: 明石海峽大橋以預製平行鋼絲索股（PWS）架設主纜：每股 127 根鋼絲在工廠成束、端部預裝錨頭，再沿導索與貓道牽引過海峽，290 股依序放入索鞍。每一股都必須調整到與基準索股相同的垂度，否則擠壓成纜後各股受力不均。由於主纜長度隨溫度伸縮，而垂度對長度變化極為敏感，調整通常安排在夜間溫度穩定、索股內外溫差小的時段，並以溫度修正量測值。~Akashi Kaikyo's main cables were erected with prefabricated parallel-wire strands (PWS): each bundle of 127 wires is made in the factory with sockets fitted at the ends, hauled across the strait along guide ropes and catwalks, and the 290 strands are placed in the saddles in sequence. Every strand must be adjusted to the same sag as the reference strand, otherwise the wires share load unequally after squeezing. Because cable length changes with temperature and sag is very sensitive to length, adjustment is usually done at night when temperatures are stable and the difference between strand surface and core is small, with temperature-corrected readings.
units.model: 拋物線纜長 S ≈ l + 8f²/(3l)。取 l = 1,991 m、f = 199.1 m（垂跨比 1/10）：S ≈ 1,991 + 53.1 = 2,044.1 m。溫度上升 1 °C，ΔS = 1.2×10⁻⁵×2,044.1 ≈ 0.0245 m，Δf = (3l/(16f))·ΔS = 1.875×0.0245 ≈ 0.046 m。也就是每 1 °C 垂度約改變 46 mm，5 °C 溫差即約 230 mm。數值為教學假設。~Parabolic cable length S ≈ l + 8f²/(3l). With l = 1,991 m and f = 199.1 m (sag ratio 1/10): S ≈ 1,991 + 53.1 = 2,044.1 m. A 1 °C rise gives ΔS = 1.2×10⁻⁵×2,044.1 ≈ 0.0245 m and Δf = (3l/(16f))·ΔS = 1.875×0.0245 ≈ 0.046 m, so sag changes by about 46 mm per °C and a 5 °C error means about 230 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 基準索股以全站儀或水準量測跨中與邊跨垂度，配合多點索股溫度計取平均溫度修正；其他索股以相對於基準股的高差量測調整，允收以修正後高差在數毫米至十餘毫米內為準。每日記錄氣溫、風速與量測時間，作為異常時的回溯依據。~Measure mid-span and side-span sag of the reference strand by total station or levelling with multi-point strand thermometers for temperature correction; adjust other strands by their height difference relative to the reference, accepting corrected differences within a few to about a dozen millimetres. Log air temperature, wind speed and time daily as a trace for anomalies.
units.failure: 日間陽光照射使上層索股比下層熱數度，若此時調整，夜間冷卻後各股垂度不一，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲長期過載、部分鬆弛；鬆弛鋼絲在纜內會形成鼓起，影響索夾夾緊與防護包覆。~Adjusting in daytime sun, when top strands run several degrees warmer than lower ones, leaves unequal sags after night cooling; once squeezed, some wires are permanently overloaded and others slack, and slack wires bulge inside the cable, spoiling cable-band clamping and wrapping.
units.misconception: 索股垂度只要白天量一次，誤差幾公分不影響主纜受力。~Measuring strand sag once in daytime is fine; a few centimetres of error do not affect cable forces.
units.practice: 索股調整的量測時段、溫度計位置與修正公式應寫入施工規範；基準索股須定期複測，若連續數股偏差同向，先停工檢查基準點與溫度修正，再繼續牽引。~The specification should fix the measuring window, thermometer positions and correction formula for strand adjustment; the reference strand must be re-surveyed periodically, and if several strands deviate in the same direction, stop to check the benchmarks and temperature correction before hauling more.

units.anchor: 1995 年地震後桁段加長~Post-1995 truss lengthening
units.title: 跨徑變化後的垂度與桁段修正~Sag change and truss correction after the span grew
units.mechanism: 1995 年 1 月 17 日地震發生時，主塔已完成、所有索股已架設，正在進行主纜擠壓，加勁桁尚未架設。斷層錯動使基礎隨地盤移動，中央跨徑約增加 0.8 m。由於主纜長度已固定，跨徑變長意味著垂度變小、張力略增；設計團隊重新計算後，把尚未製造的加勁桁構件在中央跨加長 800 mm、淡路側邊跨加長 340 mm，使完工線形仍與主纜幾何相容。公開論文指出中央跨垂度約減少 1.3 m，主纜張力增加約為原設計最大張力的 0.6%，仍在容許範圍內。~When the earthquake struck on 17 January 1995 the towers were complete and all strands erected, cable squeezing was in progress and the stiffening truss had not yet been erected. Fault movement carried the foundations with the ground and lengthened the centre span by about 0.8 m. With the cable length already fixed, a longer span means less sag and slightly more tension; after re-analysis the team lengthened truss members not yet fabricated by 800 mm in the centre span and 340 mm in the Awaji side span so that the completed profile stayed compatible with the cable geometry. The published paper reports a centre-span sag reduction of about 1.3 m and an extra cable tension of about 0.6% of the original maximum, within the allowable.
units.model: 纜長固定時 dS = (1 − 8n²/3)·dl + (16f/(3l))·df = 0，故 df = −dl·(1 − 8n²/3)·3l/(16f)。取 n = 0.1、l = 1,991 m、f = 199.1 m、dl = 0.8 m：df = −0.8×0.973×1.875 ≈ −1.46 m。不可伸長假設高估了垂度變化；實際張力增加使主纜彈性伸長、塔頂也有變位，公開報告值約 1.3 m。n 為教學假設。~With fixed cable length dS = (1 − 8n²/3)·dl + (16f/(3l))·df = 0, so df = −dl·(1 − 8n²/3)·3l/(16f). With n = 0.1, l = 1,991 m, f = 199.1 m and dl = 0.8 m: df = −0.8×0.973×1.875 ≈ −1.46 m. The inextensible assumption overestimates the change; the extra tension stretches the cable elastically and the tower tops also move, and the published value is about 1.3 m. n is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 事件後以 GPS 與精密測量重新建立各基礎與塔頂座標，量測主纜各跨垂度與索鞍位置，回饋到完工線形分析；加長的桁段在工廠以修正圖說製造，架設中逐段比對節點高程與預測值，最終與設計車道縱斷面比較。~After the event re-establish coordinates of every foundation and tower top by GPS and precise survey, measure cable sag in each span and saddle positions, and feed them into the final-profile analysis; fabricate the lengthened members to revised drawings and compare node levels with predictions segment by segment during erection, finally checking against the design road profile.
units.failure: 若沿用原設計長度製造加勁桁，桁段與吊索幾何不相容，合龍時會出現強迫的拉壓力與伸縮縫錯位；未重新檢核塔底應力與主纜張力，也可能低估地震造成的永久附加應力（公開論文報告塔底附加應力最大約 18.2 N/mm²）。~Fabricating the truss to the original lengths would make segments incompatible with hanger geometry, forcing tension and compression at closure and misaligning expansion joints; skipping a re-check of tower-base stress and cable tension could miss the permanent added stress from the quake (the paper reports up to about 18.2 N/mm² at the tower base).
units.misconception: 地震後只要把橋塔推回原位，就能維持原設計線形。~After an earthquake you simply push the towers back to restore the design profile.
units.practice: 大型懸索橋施工期間應持續保存基礎、塔頂與主纜的測量基準與時間序列，並預先規劃「事件後重新測量—重算線形—修正未製構件」的決策流程與核准層級；修正圖說須由設計者簽認後才可投料。~During construction of a major suspension bridge keep survey baselines and time series for foundations, tower tops and cables, and plan in advance the decision path of post-event survey, profile re-analysis and revision of unfabricated members with its approval levels; revised drawings must be signed by the designer before steel is cut.

units.anchor: 全橋氣彈模型與颱風實測~Full model and typhoon records
units.title: 全橋模型試驗與颱風實測比對~Full-bridge model tests versus typhoon records
units.mechanism: 斷面模型只能代表二維流場，懸索橋的顫振與抖振卻牽涉多個三維模態、主纜與塔的氣動力，以及沿跨長變化的紊流。明石海峽大橋因此在大型風洞中做全橋氣彈模型試驗，模型需同時滿足幾何、質量、勁度與重力相似，以 Froude 相似律換算風速與頻率；完工後研究者再以颱風期間的風速計、加速度計與 GPS 實測，比對抖振位移與模態阻尼，驗證設計假設。~A section model represents only two-dimensional flow, while flutter and buffeting of a suspension bridge involve several three-dimensional modes, aerodynamic forces on cables and towers, and turbulence that varies along the span. Akashi Kaikyo was therefore tested with a full aeroelastic model in a large wind tunnel, which must reproduce geometry, mass, stiffness and gravity together, with wind speed and frequency scaled by Froude similarity; after completion researchers compared buffeting displacement and modal damping with anemometer, accelerometer and GPS records from typhoons to validate the design assumptions.
units.model: Froude 相似：長度比 λ = 1/100 時，風速比 √λ = 1/10、頻率比 1/√λ = 10、單位長質量比 λ² = 1/10,000。實橋 80 m/s 對應模型 8 m/s；0.065 Hz 對應 0.65 Hz；44,000 kg/m 對應 4.4 kg/m；全長 3,911 m 的模型約 39 m。數值為教學假設。~Froude similarity: with length scale λ = 1/100, velocity scales by √λ = 1/10, frequency by 1/√λ = 10 and mass per length by λ² = 1/10,000. A full-scale 80 m/s maps to 8 m/s in the model, 0.065 Hz to 0.65 Hz, 44,000 kg/m to 4.4 kg/m, and the 3,911 m bridge becomes a model about 39 m long. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 模型先做自由振動試驗確認各模態頻率與阻尼符合相似要求，再在均勻流與紊流中逐級提高風速記錄位移與發散點；實橋比對時把颱風紀錄依平均風速分段，以頻譜辨識模態頻率與阻尼，並比較量測抖振位移與預測值的比值。~First run free-vibration tests on the model to confirm modal frequencies and damping meet similarity, then raise wind speed step by step in smooth and turbulent flow, recording displacement and divergence; for full-scale comparison bin typhoon records by mean wind speed, identify frequencies and damping from spectra, and compare the ratio of measured to predicted buffeting displacement.
units.failure: 模型阻尼過高或質量分布不符，會使顫振風速被高估；紊流強度與積分尺度若與海峽實況不同，抖振預測可能偏差。實測時若 GPS 多路徑誤差或風速計受橋體遮蔽未修正，也會錯誤地「驗證」或否定設計。~Excess damping or wrong mass distribution in the model overestimates the flutter speed; turbulence intensity and integral scale unlike the strait's can bias buffeting predictions. In field data, uncorrected GPS multipath or anemometers shielded by the deck can falsely confirm or reject the design.
units.misconception: 全橋模型的風速必須和實橋一樣，試驗才有意義。~A full-bridge model is only meaningful if tested at the same wind speed as the real bridge.
units.practice: 試驗計畫應明列相似律、模型頻率與阻尼的允差、紊流條件與試驗風攻角；完工監測報告要附原始資料與處理參數，讓日後研究者能以新方法重新分析並與風洞結果比較。~The test plan must state the similarity law, tolerances on model frequency and damping, turbulence conditions and angles of attack; completion monitoring reports should include raw data and processing parameters so later researchers can reanalyse them and compare with the tunnel results.

units.anchor: 長吊索尾流振動~Long-hanger wake vibration
units.title: 長吊索尾流振動與螺旋纏絲~Long-hanger wake vibration and helical wire
units.mechanism: 明石海峽大橋部分吊索長度超過 200 m，每個索夾處有並排的平行鋼絲吊索，間距約為吊索直徑的 9 倍。完工後觀察到在約 20 m/s 的風中，背風側吊索因位於迎風吊索的尾流中而大幅振動；過去一般認為這類尾流馳振只在間距小於約 5 倍直徑時發生。風洞試驗顯示，在吊索表面螺旋纏繞直徑 10 mm 的鋼絲可打亂尾流與表面分離，降低振動，營運單位並開發了纏絲機械施作。~Some Akashi Kaikyo hangers exceed 200 m, and at each cable band parallel-wire hanger ropes run side by side at a spacing of about nine rope diameters. After completion the leeward ropes were seen vibrating strongly in winds of about 20 m/s because they sat in the wake of the windward ropes; such wake galloping had previously been thought to occur only at spacings below about five diameters. Wind-tunnel tests showed that winding 10 mm wire helically around the rope disrupts the wake and surface separation and reduces the vibration, and the operator developed a winding machine to install it.
units.model: 弦頻率 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。取 L = 200 m、T = 1.6 MN、m = 40 kg/m：√(T/m) = 200 m/s，f₁ = 200/400 = 0.5 Hz。直徑 D = 0.09 m、風速 20 m/s 時折減風速 U/(f·D) = 20/(0.5×0.09) ≈ 444，遠高於渦振範圍，屬尾流馳振區；間距 9D ≈ 0.81 m。數值為教學假設。~String frequency f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With L = 200 m, T = 1.6 MN and m = 40 kg/m: √(T/m) = 200 m/s and f₁ = 200/400 = 0.5 Hz. With D = 0.09 m at 20 m/s the reduced velocity U/(f·D) = 20/(0.5×0.09) ≈ 444, far above the vortex range and in the wake-galloping regime; the spacing 9D ≈ 0.81 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在代表性吊索上安裝加速度計與風速風向計，記錄振幅與風向、風速的關係，辨識振動只出現在特定風向與背風索；風洞中以成對索段試驗有無纏絲、不同纏繞節距的反應，選定方案後再在實橋試裝並比較前後振幅。~Fit accelerometers and anemometers to representative hangers and relate amplitude to wind speed and direction, confirming that vibration appears only for certain directions and on the leeward rope; in the wind tunnel test paired rope segments with and without wire and with different pitches, then trial-fit the chosen scheme on the bridge and compare amplitudes before and after.
units.failure: 長吊索反覆大振幅擺動會使索夾出口與錨頭處彎曲應力集中、鋼絲磨損與疲勞，兩索相互碰撞也會損傷護套與防蝕層，讓水分進入吊索內部。~Repeated large swings of long hangers concentrate bending stress where the rope exits the cable band and at its socket, wearing and fatiguing the wires; ropes striking each other also damage sheathing and corrosion protection and let water into the rope.
units.misconception: 只要吊索間距大於 5 倍直徑，就不會有尾流振動。~Hangers spaced more than five diameters apart can never suffer wake vibration.
units.practice: 長吊索的振動觀測應從完工初期就納入監測計畫，特定風向的異常振動要記錄並回報設計者；纏絲、阻尼器或連結件等對策必須先經風洞或試裝驗證，並確認不妨礙日後的磁通檢測。~Observation of long-hanger vibration should be in the monitoring plan from the first year, recording and reporting unusual vibration in particular wind directions; wire winding, dampers or ties must be proven by wind-tunnel tests or trial fitting and must not obstruct later magnetic-flux inspection.

units.anchor: 主纜送氣出口濕度~Cable exhaust humidity
units.title: 主纜乾燥空氣的水分收支~Moisture budget of cable dry-air injection
units.mechanism: 本州四國連絡橋的檢查發現，舊有懸索橋拆開鍍鋅纏絲後鋼絲已有鏽蝕，因此開發了將乾燥空氣送入主纜內部的系統，並以世界首創的形式用於明石海峽大橋與其他懸索橋。管理目標是纜內相對濕度 40%，比會發生腐蝕的約 60% 留有安全餘裕；夏季高濕時另加預冷設備除濕。乾燥空氣沿主纜空隙流動，一路蒸發並帶走殘留水分，最後從排氣口排出，排氣口的濕度就是纜內是否已乾燥的指標。~Inspections of older Honshu-Shikoku suspension bridges found rust on wires once the galvanised wrapping was removed, so a system injecting dry air into the main cable was developed and used, as a world first, on Akashi Kaikyo and the other suspension bridges. The management target is 40% relative humidity inside the cable, a margin below the roughly 60% at which corrosion occurs; pre-coolers dehumidify humid summer air. The dry air travels through the cable voids, evaporating and carrying away trapped moisture before leaving at exhaust points, so exhaust humidity is the indicator of whether the cable interior is dry.
units.model: 25 °C 飽和水氣密度約 23.0 g/m³。送入 15% RH 空氣（3.5 g/m³），出口 40% RH（9.2 g/m³），每立方公尺帶走約 5.7 g。流量 1.0 m³/min 時每日 1,440 m³，約 8.2 kg 水；若段內殘留 50 kg 水，約 6 天才能排除。主纜空隙約 0.989×20% ≈ 0.198 m³/m。數值為教學假設。~Saturated vapour density at 25 °C is about 23.0 g/m³. Injecting air at 15% RH (3.5 g/m³) with exhaust at 40% RH (9.2 g/m³) removes about 5.7 g per cubic metre. At 1.0 m³/min, 1,440 m³ a day carries about 8.2 kg of water, so 50 kg trapped in a section takes about 6 days to clear. Cable voids are about 0.989×20% ≈ 0.198 m³ per metre. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在每個送氣與排氣口連續記錄溫度、相對濕度與流量，計算各段的露點與水分移除量；排氣濕度持續高於目標時，先檢查包覆氣密與送氣壓力，再於低點開窗目視檢查鋼絲鍍鋅狀態。~Log temperature, relative humidity and flow continuously at every injection and exhaust point, computing dew point and moisture removal per section; if exhaust humidity stays above target, first check wrapping airtightness and supply pressure, then open an inspection window at a low point to inspect the zinc on the wires.
units.failure: 包覆破損或索夾密封失效會讓乾燥空氣從近端漏出，遠端仍潮濕，平均讀值卻看似正常；送氣設備故障未被警報偵測時，纜內濕度數週內就可能回升到腐蝕門檻以上。~Damaged wrapping or failed cable-band seals let dry air escape near the inlet while the far end stays wet, even though average readings look normal; an equipment fault not caught by alarms can let internal humidity climb above the corrosion threshold within weeks.
units.misconception: 主纜外面有鍍鋅纏絲與塗裝，內部就不會潮濕。~With galvanised wrapping and paint outside, the cable interior cannot get wet.
units.practice: 把每個區段的排氣濕度、流量與設備運轉狀態納入中央監控與警報，維修紀錄須連結到區段編號；包覆修補、索夾更換等作業後要重新做氣密與流量確認，才算結案。~Bring exhaust humidity, flow and equipment status for every section into central monitoring with alarms, link maintenance records to section numbers, and close out wrapping repairs or cable-band work only after airtightness and flow are re-verified.

units.anchor: 塔內 TMD 與 200 年目標~Tower TMDs and 200-year target
units.title: 減振裝置維護與 200 年資產管理~Damper upkeep and 200-year asset management
units.mechanism: 本州四國連絡橋的維護方針以 200 年以上的長期使用為目標，以預防保全與資產管理把生命週期成本降到最低。明石海峽主塔為十字形斷面，風洞試驗顯示若無減振裝置，塔在橫向風中振幅可達約 95 cm，裝設 TMD 與附加阻尼器後約 10 cm，容許值 30 cm；公開簡報列出共約 40 組 TMD 與 8 組附加阻尼器。營運後實測塔位移小於約 2 cm，營運單位因而研究把減振裝置的維護週期由每 5 年延長到約 14 年。這是以監測數據調整維護投入的典型案例。~The Honshu-Shikoku maintenance policy targets service of 200 years or more, minimising life-cycle cost through preventive maintenance and asset management. The Akashi Kaikyo towers have a cruciform section; wind-tunnel tests showed transverse-wind amplitudes of about 95 cm without dampers and about 10 cm with TMDs and additional dampers, against an allowable 30 cm, and a public presentation lists about 40 TMDs and 8 additional dampers. Measured tower displacement in service stayed below about 2 cm, so the operator studied extending the damper maintenance interval from every 5 years to about 14 years, a typical case of using monitoring data to tune maintenance effort.
units.model: 渦振振幅約與總阻尼成反比。設塔結構阻尼 ζ_s = 0.5%，95 cm 降到 10 cm 需總阻尼 0.5%×95/10 ≈ 4.75%，即 TMD 附加約 4.25%；要符合 30 cm 只需 0.5%×95/30 ≈ 1.58%。若 TMD 劣化使附加阻尼減半，總阻尼約 2.6%，振幅約 95×0.5/2.6 ≈ 18 cm，仍低於容許值。阻尼比為教學假設。~Vortex-induced amplitude is roughly inversely proportional to total damping. With tower damping ζ_s = 0.5%, cutting 95 cm to 10 cm needs about 0.5%×95/10 ≈ 4.75% in total, so the TMDs add about 4.25%; meeting 30 cm needs only 0.5%×95/30 ≈ 1.58%. If TMD ageing halves the added damping, the total is about 2.6% and the amplitude about 95×0.5/2.6 ≈ 18 cm, still within the limit. Damping ratios are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以塔內加速度與位移長期紀錄，篩選可能引發振動的強風事件，比較實測振幅與設計預測；定期抽驗 TMD 的頻率與阻尼係數，並做阻尼變化 ±20%、±50% 的敏感度分析，確認延長維護週期後仍滿足容許位移。~Use long-term tower acceleration and displacement records to pick out strong-wind events capable of exciting vibration and compare measured amplitudes with design predictions; periodically spot-check TMD frequency and damping coefficient, and run sensitivity analyses for ±20% and ±50% damping changes to confirm that the allowable displacement is still met with a longer interval.
units.failure: 若不看監測數據而一律縮短週期，維護成本與封閉作業增加卻無性能收益；反之若沒有敏感度分析就延長週期，TMD 卡滯或失調可能在下一次強風時才被發現，塔與索鞍承受未預期的反覆應力。~Shortening intervals regardless of monitoring data adds cost and closures for no performance gain; extending them without sensitivity analysis can leave a stuck or detuned TMD undiscovered until the next strong wind, exposing towers and saddles to unexpected cyclic stress.
units.misconception: 減振裝置維護得越頻繁，橋梁一定越安全。~The more often dampers are serviced, the safer the bridge must be.
units.practice: 任何維護週期的延長都要附上監測證據、敏感度分析與重新評估的觸發條件（例如觀測到某風速以上的事件或振幅超過門檻），並由業主的技術委員會核准；檢查與修繕紀錄納入資料庫以 PDCA 循環更新計畫。~Any extension of a maintenance interval must come with monitoring evidence, sensitivity analysis and re-assessment triggers (such as an event above a given wind speed or amplitude above a threshold), approved by the owner's technical committee; inspection and repair records go into the database so the plan is updated through a PDCA cycle.

example: 延伸練習：假設主跨 l = 1,991 m、垂跨比 n = 1/10（f = 199.1 m），兩條主纜與加勁梁合計恆載 w = 431.6 kN/m（44 t/m）。水平張力 H = w·l²/(8f) = 431.6×1,991²/(8×199.1) ≈ 1,074,000 kN，每纜 537 MN；塔頂最大張力 T = H·√(1+16n²) = 537×1.077 ≈ 578 MN。每纜鋼絲面積 0.791 m²，恆載應力 = 578/0.791 ≈ 731 N/mm²，對 1,760 N/mm² 鋼絲的恆載安全係數約 2.41；若活載與溫度再使張力增加 10%，係數降為約 2.19。若改用 1,570 N/mm² 鋼絲而面積不變，恆載係數只剩約 2.15，這正是公開資料說需要每側兩條纜的原因。地震後跨徑若增加 0.8 m，不可伸長估算垂度減少約 1.46 m。數值為教學假設，不代表明石海峽大橋的設計計算。~Extension exercise: assume l = 1,991 m, sag ratio n = 1/10 (f = 199.1 m) and a dead load for both cables and the girder of w = 431.6 kN/m (44 t/m). Horizontal tension H = w·l²/(8f) = 431.6×1,991²/(8×199.1) ≈ 1,074,000 kN, or 537 MN per cable; maximum tension at the tower T = H·√(1+16n²) = 537×1.077 ≈ 578 MN. With 0.791 m² of wire per cable the dead-load stress is 578/0.791 ≈ 731 N/mm², a dead-load safety factor of about 2.41 on 1,760 N/mm² wire; if live load and temperature add 10% to tension the factor drops to about 2.19. With 1,570 N/mm² wire and the same area the dead-load factor would be only about 2.15, which is why the public account says two cables per side would have been needed. A 0.8 m span increase after the earthquake reduces sag by about 1.46 m in the inextensible estimate. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge.
history: 本州四國連絡橋公團於 1970 年成立，明石海峽大橋 1986 年動土、1988 年 5 月現場開工，1998 年 4 月 5 日通車，以 1,991 m 主跨保持世界紀錄直到 2022 年。工程首度在長大橋使用 180 kgf/mm² 級高強度鋼絲、設置沉箱與抗水洗水中混凝土，並以直升機牽引導索避免干擾繁忙航道；1995 年兵庫縣南部地震在主纜擠壓期間發生，設計團隊以修正桁段長度吸收跨徑變化。營運後的主纜乾燥空氣、吊索纏絲與減振裝置維護研究，成為長大橋預防保全的公開參考。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Authority was set up in 1970; Akashi Kaikyo broke ground in 1986, began site work in May 1988 and opened on 5 April 1998, its 1,991 m main span holding the world record until 2022. It was the first long-span bridge to use 180 kgf/mm² class high-strength wire, used laid-down caissons with antiwashout underwater concrete, and flew its pilot rope by helicopter to keep a busy shipping lane open; the 1995 Hyogo-ken Nanbu earthquake struck during cable squeezing, and the designers absorbed the span change by revising truss member lengths. In service, its dry-air cable system, hanger wire winding and damper maintenance studies became public references for preventive maintenance of long-span bridges. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 中央跨 1,991 m、全長 3,911 m，1998 年 4 月 5 日通車~Centre span 1,991 m, total length 3,911 m, opened on 5 April 1998
主塔高約 300 m，為三跨二鉸加勁桁架懸索橋~Towers about 300 m tall on a three-span, two-hinged truss-stiffened suspension bridge
180 kgf/mm²（約 1,760 N/mm²）鋼絲使每側只需一條約 1,100 mm 主纜，而非兩條約 1,000 mm~180 kgf/mm² (about 1,760 N/mm²) wire allowed one cable of about 1,100 mm per side instead of two of about 1,000 mm
每條主纜 290 股、每股 127 根 5.23 mm 鋼絲，外徑約 1.12 m~Each cable has 290 strands of 127 wires of 5.23 mm, about 1.12 m in diameter
2P 鋼沉箱外徑 80 m、內徑 56 m、高約 65 m，內核水中混凝土約 270,000 m³~The 2P steel caisson is 80 m outer and 56 m inner diameter, about 65 m high, with about 270,000 m³ of underwater core concrete
1995 年地震後中央跨加勁桁加長 800 mm、淡路側邊跨加長 340 mm，中央跨垂度約減少 1.3 m~After the 1995 quake truss members were lengthened 800 mm in the centre span and 340 mm in the Awaji side span; centre-span sag fell about 1.3 m
主纜乾燥空氣管理目標為相對濕度 40%，腐蝕門檻約 60%~Dry-air management target is 40% relative humidity inside the cable, against a corrosion threshold of about 60%
部分吊索超過 200 m，間距約 9D 時在約 20 m/s 風中出現尾流振動，以 10 mm 螺旋纏絲抑制~Some hangers exceed 200 m; at about 9D spacing wake vibration appeared in winds of about 20 m/s and was suppressed with 10 mm helical wire
風洞試驗中主塔無阻尼器振幅約 95 cm，加裝 TMD 等後約 10 cm，容許 30 cm~In wind-tunnel tests tower amplitude was about 95 cm without dampers and about 10 cm with TMDs, against an allowable 30 cm
加勁桁架寬約 35.5 m、深約 14 m~The stiffening truss is about 35.5 m wide and 14 m deep

place.name: 明石海峽大橋~Akashi Kaikyo Bridge

sources.title: 本州四國連絡高速道路：長大橋上部結構維護技術
sources.titleEn: Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Expressway: Maintenance technology for long-span bridge superstructures
sources.scope: 營運單位說明主纜乾燥空氣系統的 40% 濕度目標、吊索尾流振動與纏絲對策、磁通檢測與塗裝策略。
sources.scopeEn: Operator page on the 40% humidity target of dry-air cable injection, hanger wake vibration and helical-wire countermeasure, magnetic-flux inspection and coating strategy.

sources.title: 本州四國連絡高速道路：材料開發（高強度鋼絲與水中混凝土）
sources.titleEn: Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Expressway: Development of materials (high-strength wire and underwater concrete)
sources.scope: 說明 180 kgf/mm² 鋼絲讓每側只需一條主纜，以及水中不分離混凝土與低熱水泥的開發背景。
sources.scopeEn: Explains how 180 kgf/mm² wire allowed one cable per side, and the background of non-segregating underwater concrete and low-heat cement.

sources.title: 明石海峽大橋耐震設計與兵庫縣南部地震時的行為（WCEE 論文）
sources.titleEn: Seismic design and behaviour during the Hyogo-ken Nanbu earthquake of the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge (WCEE paper)
sources.publisher: World Conference on Earthquake Engineering (authors from the Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Authority)
sources.scope: 業主技術人員撰寫的地震行為報告：基礎位移、跨徑變化、桁段加長量、垂度與張力變化；本課計算另為教學假設。
sources.scopeEn: Owner engineers' report on foundation movement, span change, truss lengthening, sag and tension changes; course calculations are separate teaching assumptions.

sources.title: 明石海峽大橋主塔基礎大型鋼沉箱水中混凝土的自動化施工（ISARC 論文）
sources.titleEn: Automation and robotics of underwater concreting in the huge steel caissons of the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge tower foundations (ISARC paper)
sources.publisher: International Association for Automation and Robotics in Construction
sources.scope: 沉箱尺寸、水中混凝土數量、層厚、澆置管與泵送設備等施工數據；不含設計計算。
sources.scopeEn: Construction data on caisson size, underwater concrete volume, layer thickness, tremie pipes and pumping plant; no design calculations.

sources.title: 明石海峽大橋減振裝置維護減量研究（PIARC 2011 簡報）
sources.titleEn: Study on reduction of vibration control devices for the Akashi-Kaikyo Bridge (PIARC 2011 presentation)
sources.publisher: PIARC World Road Congress 2011 (Honshu-Shikoku Bridge Expressway)
sources.scope: 營運單位簡報：主塔 TMD 數量、風洞與實測位移、容許值與維護週期延長研究。
sources.scopeEn: Operator presentation on tower TMD numbers, wind-tunnel and measured displacements, the allowable value and the maintenance-interval study.
